metadata.description: Every station of FMI's four snow-depth networks (automatic weather, manned weather, climate and precipitation stations), open and closed. Daily snow depth, no SWE. fmi_served says whether the observation service knows the station; codes are FMI-<fmisid>.

properties.name: Jämijärvi Lahden talo
properties.notes: Finnish Meteorological Institute open data, CC BY 4.0. Snow depth only (no SWE). A value of -1 upstream (snow-free ground) is archived as 0 cm.

data_variables.name: snow
data_variables.notes: At automatic stations the 06:00 UTC reading of the dated day (checked against snow_aws, 2024); at manual stations the observer's reading, time not stated. -1 (snow-free ground) is returned as 0.0, flag 'snow_free'.

data_variables.name: rrday
data_variables.notes: -1 (no precipitation) is returned as 0.0, flag 'no_precipitation'. The 24 h period's boundaries are not stated by the service.
